neighbours.label: thanking someone for their time: 'thank you (so much) for taking/finding the time'
fire: Dear Dr. Lee, thank you so much for taking time to speak with our students.
Once again, thank you very much for finding time in your busy schedule.
On behalf of the club, thank you so much for taking the time to visit us.
Thanks so much for making time to review my application this week.
Everyone here wants to say thank you for taking time out of your weekend.
Again, thank you so much for finding the time to answer our questions.
We really appreciate it, and thank you for taking time to fill out the survey.
As always, thank you so much for taking time to read this newsletter.
quiet: Dear Dr. Lee, we hope you can speak with our students next month.
Once again, the meeting was moved because of your busy schedule.
On behalf of the club, we invite you to visit us this spring.
Please review my application when you have a free moment this week.
Everyone here spent time out of their weekend to clean the park.
Again, we will try to answer all of the questions in the next issue.
We really need more people to fill out the survey before Friday.
As always, this newsletter covers the latest news from the school.

notes: Probe: 'Thank you so much for taking time' 0.77; 'take the time to thank ... for' 0.35; thanks to all who 0.23-0.26; same frame without thanks 0.08; 'grateful for' 0.03.
